description: Three rounds of one bivariate-bicycle [[90,8,10]] block as a Z memory, read out in the program; every ion reset; then three rounds as an X memory, read out by the grader (180 ions: 90 data and 90 check ancillas; 8 logical qubits). Two copies would need 360 ions, over Goal 1's 200, so the two bases are measured one after the other on the same ions; a round is one memory's. Circuit distance 10 with bare checks; decoded with BP-OSD, its belief propagation capped at 30 iterations. Ranked with every Goal 1 code by the logical error rate per round per logical qubit under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
